request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only the right edge: remove the goblin's outstretched arm with the torch and the plank sticking out at the lower right, so nothing reaches past the cart's right side; the goblin instead holds a small lit match up in front of his chest, and his skin becomes a mid-tone olive leaf green. Keep everything else the same: the five paper rockets, their colours, stars and cream cones, sticks, rope, fuse spark, wooden cart, wheels, orange cap, thick black outline and art style.
